note.question: How does online retail reduce the costs of obtaining information about a product’s price and availability and of flexibly timing a purchase?
note.overview: Online retail reduces the costs of obtaining information about a product’s price and availability and of flexibly timing a purchase. Consequently, consumers can strategically time their purchases, weighing the costs of monitoring and the risk of inventory depletion against prospectively lower prices. At the same time, firms can observe and exploit their customers’ monitoring behavior.
